title: Forrestal flown to Hobe Sound, reported belt suicide attempt

tellings.quote: there, he apparently, we're told, tried to hang himself with his belt.

plain: In 1949 Forrestal, the US defense secretary, was flown to Hobe Sound in Florida, and there, it is said, he tried to hang himself with his belt. The researcher Richard Dolan, who writes about UFO history, tells this and is careful to mark it as hearsay ("he apparently, we're told"), pointing to an account tied to a man he calls William Manager. Dolan tells it as part of the story of Forrestal's breakdown and death, which he links to UFO secrecy.
